# netbox_inventory_item (Data Source)

Reads a single NetBox inventory item (`/api/dcim/inventory-items/`) by `id`, `name` or filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
data "netbox_inventory_item" "example" {
  name = "example"
}

# Lookup by arbitrary API filters:
data "netbox_inventory_item" "filtered" {
  filters = [
    { name = "id", value = "123" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/dcim/inventory-items/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `name` (String) Name.

### Read-Only

- `asset_tag` (String) A unique tag used to identify this item.
- `component_id` (Number) Component Id.
- `component_type` (String) Component Type.
- `created` (String) Created.
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `depth` (Number) Depth.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `device_id` (Number) ID of the Device (`netbox_device`).
- `discovered` (Boolean) This item was automatically discovered. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `display_url` (String) Display Url.
- `label` (String) Physical label. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `manufacturer_id` (Number) ID of the Manufacturer (`netbox_manufacturer`).
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `parent_id` (Number) ID of the Inventory Item (`netbox_inventory_item`).
- `part_id` (String) Manufacturer-assigned part identifier. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `role_id` (Number) ID of the Inventory Item Role (`netbox_inventory_item_role`).
- `serial` (String) Serial. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `status` (String) Status. Valid values: `offline`, `active`, `planned`, `staged`, `failed`, `decommissioning`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `url` (String) Url.

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.
